rules.name: HttpServerErrorRatioHigh
rules.query: sum by (application) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{status=~"5..",uri!~"/actuator.*"}[5m])) / sum by (application) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{uri!~"/actuator.*"}[5m])) > 0.05 and sum by (application) (increase(http_server_requests_seconds_count{uri!~"/actuator.*"}[5m])) >= 20

annotations.summary: More than 5% of the requests to {{ $labels.application }} end in a server error
Most clinical questions are ending as unavailable
The circuit breaker of the LLM node {{ $labels.name }} has not closed again
The urgency projection is behind on partition {{ $labels.partition }}
The oldest unpublished outbox event is more than two minutes old
Outbox events are flagged for operator review (ADR-03)

queries.expr: sum by (application, status) (clamp_min(http_server_requests_seconds_count{status=~"4..|5.."} - http_server_requests_seconds_count{status=~"4..|5.."} offset 1m, 0) or (http_server_requests_seconds_count{status=~"4..|5.."} unless http_server_requests_seconds_count{status=~"4..|5.."} offset 1m))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, application, method, uri) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_bucket{uri!~"/actuator/.*|/health.*|/prometheus|/v3/api-docs.*|/swagger-ui.*|/webjars.*"}[5m])))
